designationHistory.name: Aransas Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Aransas Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7784; it is now Aransas National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Aransas National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7784—Establishing the Aransas Migratory Waterfowl Refuge (Dec 31, 1937)

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Aransas National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1937 to serve as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife and as an inviolate sanctuary, or for any other management purpose, for migratory birds.
